GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 560 (24 Nov 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 344)
24 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation Vessel for Japanese Residents in Canton.
1． Reference is made to your request in C. L. O. No. 658 (3.2), dated 20 November 1945, subject: "Repatriation Vessel for Japanese Residents in Canton."
2． As the port of Canton is not mine free, no action can be taken at this time.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
